.replace("••","")

.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?\d+/,'$1')
.replace(/^(\d+)、/,'第$1章 ')
.replace(/^(第.+章)\s?第.+章/,'$1')
.replace(/第\s(.+)\s章/,'第$1章')
.replace(/.*(chapter|Chapter)\s?(\d+)\s?/,'$1 $2 ')
.replace(/\(.+\)/,'')
.replace(/\[|。/,'')

设置1️⃣：打开小说 - 菜单 - 登录 - 点击下方按钮

1️⃣编辑书源：菜单 - 登录 - 点击【 👀 查看屏蔽】

3️⃣输入内容：在【输入内容】处输入屏蔽内容

2️⃣输入内容：输入标签，点击【📌 喜欢标签】

2️⃣输入内容：输入作者ID，点击【❤️ 他人收藏】

设置1️⃣：打开小说 - 菜单 - 登录 - 点击下方按钮

exploreUrl:
<js>
var discover = [];
var showR18 = false;
var push = (title, url, style) => {
    discover.push({
        title: title,
        url: url,
        style: {
            layout_flexGrow: 1,
            layout_flexBasisPercent: style
        }
    });
};
var addSlots = (count, style) => {
    var remainder = count % 3;
    var slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (var i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("书架", null, 1);
try {
    var favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
    if (favored.includes("Token不合法或者过期")) {
    	   showR18 = false;
        push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    } else {
    	   showR18 = true;
    	   push("阅读历史", "/api/user/read-history?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30", 0.25);
        var favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {
            push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=update`, 0.25);
        });
        addSlots(1 + favoredData.length, 0.25);
    }
} catch (e) {
	   showR18 = false;
    push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
}
push("来源", null, 1);
var providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    var url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
var types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("分级", null, 1);
var levels = showR18 ? ["全部", "一般向", "R18"] : ["全部", "一般向"];
levels.forEach((level, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=${index}&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(level, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(levels.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
var sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=${index}`;
    push(sort, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(sorts.length, 0.25);
JSON.stringify(discover);
</js>

<js>
var initUrl = book.bookUrl;
var url = initUrl.includes('api/novel') ? initUrl : initUrl.replace('/novel/', '/api/novel/');
var body = initUrl.includes('api/novel') ? result : java.ajax(url);
if (body.includes('ID不合适，应当使用')) {
    var match = body.match(/\/\w+\/[\w-]+/);
    url = `${book.origin}/api/novel${match}`;
    body = java.ajax(url);
}
if (body.includes("Token不合法或者过期")) {
    java.toast("当前会话已失效，请重新登录");
}
java.put('url', url);
body;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var token = source.getLoginHeader();
update(baseUrl, token);
var value = String(book.getVariable("custom")) || String(source.getVariable());
var get = /^[1-9]$/.test(value) ? value : '1';
var config = {
    1: 'sakuraParagraphs',
    2: 'gptParagraphs',
    3: 'youdaoParagraphs',
    4: 'baiduParagraphs',
    5: 'paragraphs'
};
var data = JSON.parse(result);
var content = data[config[get]] || data[config[1]] || data[config[2]] || data[config[3]] || data[config[4]] || data[config[5]];
if (['6', '7', '8', '9'].includes(get)) {
    var cnContent = data[config[1]] || data[config[2]] || data[config[3]] || data[config[4]];
    var jpContent = data[config[5]];
    if (cnContent) {
        if (['8', '9'].includes(get)) {
            var res = java.post(
                'https://static.kksk.io/api/kanji',
                JSON.stringify({"content": format(regex(jpContent))}),
                {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            );
            var kanji = JSON.parse(res.body());
            jpContent = jpContent.map(text => annotate(text, kanji));
        }
        var type = ['6', '8'].includes(get);
        content = jpContent.flatMap((jp, i) => {
            if (!((jp || '').trim() && (cnContent[i] || '').trim())) return [];
            var pair = type ? [cnContent[i], jp] : [jp, cnContent[i]];
            return pair.filter(Boolean).concat(i === jpContent.length - 1 ? [] : '\u200B');
        }).filter(Boolean);
    } else {
        content = jpContent;
    }
}
format(regex(content));
</js>

var providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:books\d?\.fishhawk\.top|n\.novelia\.cc)\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
var url;
for (var provider in providers) {
    var match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        var providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        var novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    }
}
if (!url) {
    url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
}
url;
</js>

}

    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;

    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {

    }

    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    return [];
}

} else {

    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])

}

    java.toast('当前为' + tabTips[catalog.tab] + '模式');
}

let op = {
    method: "POST",
    body: {
        source: catalog.source,
        url: catalog.url,
        name: catalog.name
    }
};

let catalogUrl = getServerHost() +`/catalog,${JSON.stringify(op)}`;
let response = java.ajax(catalogUrl);

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

let device = deviceType() ? 'android' : 'ios';

if (device == 'android') {
    var typeMap = {audio:32, comic:64};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 8;
} else {
    var typeMap = {audio:1, comic:2, video:3};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 0;
}

JSON.parse(response).data.map((x) => {
    const isFanqieApp = ['番茄小说', '番茄短剧', '番茄听书', '番茄畅听'].includes(catalog.source);
    const urlToMatch = x.url || catalog.url;
    const bookId = urlToMatch.match(/book_id=(\d{19})\b/)?.[1] || null;
    const itemId = urlToMatch.match(/item_id=(\d+)/)?.[1] || null;
    
    let contentUrl = getServerHost() + `/chapter?cid=${x.cid}&source=${catalog.source}`;
    
    if (!isFanqieApp) {
        contentUrl += `&url=${catalog.url}`;
    } else {
        contentUrl += `&book_id=${bookId}&item_id=${itemId}`;
        
        if (['番茄听书', '番茄畅听'].includes(catalog.source)) {
            const toneId = Number((source.getLoginInfoMap())['听书AI音色编号']) || 1;
            contentUrl += `&tone_id=${toneId}`;
        }
    }
    
    if (catalog.source == '番茄小说') {
        const commentPart = `{"js":"book ? result : '${getServerHost()}/comment?sessionid=${getSessionId()}&item_id=${itemId}&book_id=${bookId}'"}`;
        x.url = `${contentUrl},${commentPart}`;
    } else {
        x.url = contentUrl;
    }
    
    return x;
});
</js>

base = baseUrl;
id = baseUrl.match(/(\d+\/)/)[1]
java.put("id",id)
lis = java.getElements('#list-chapterAll@dd');
var list = [];

for (var i = 0; i < lis.length; i++) {
     var href = lis[i].select('a').attr('href');
     var text = lis[i].text();
     if (href==0) {
        if ( i < lis.length - 1 ) {
            var url = "https://www.baidu.com/" + id + lis[i + 1].select('a').attr('href');         
        } else {
            var url = "https://cn.bing.com/" + id + lis[i - 1].select('a').attr('href');
        }
     } else { var url = base + href; }
     java.log(lis[i].text()+":"+url);
     list.push({"text": text, "href": url});
}

list
</js>

chart.url="https://m.qidian.com/chapter/"+bookId+"/"+o.id+"/"
}
charts.push(chart);
})
})

</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
let d = JSON.parse(result);
let limit = Number(baseUrl.match(/limit=(\d+)/)[1]);
let commentTotal  =  Number(java.getString("$.data.commentTotal"));
let page = Math.ceil(commentTotal/limit);
let p = (Number(baseUrl.match(/offset=(\d+)/)[1])/limit)+1;
function getPlainText(cl) {
    let output = "";
    let cllen = cl.length;
    let sss = String(source.getVariable());
    let re = /^([\[\]橘糖紫糖]|嗑到了|kswl|\d+\.\d+\.\d+|[1234567890一二三四五六七八九十]+刷|打卡)+$|为营造更好的评论环境，/;
    let sre = sss.match(/屏蔽【(.*?)】/)?.[1] ?? null;
    sre = sre ? new RegExp(sre.replace(/,/g, '|'), 'g') : null;    
    let plen = 0;
    let validCount = 0;

    for (let i in cl) {
        let c = cl[i];
        let reply = (c?.replyAll ?? c?.reply);
        let rl = [];
        if (re.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) : null)) {
            cllen--;
            plen++;
            continue;
        }
        
        // 处理回复
        let replyTotal = Number(c.replyTotal);
if(replyTotal > 5 && /◎缓存回复/.test(sss)) { 	
	let replyUrl = "https://android.jjwxc.net/comment/getReplyList";   
    let offset = 5;
    let limit = replyTotal; 
    let replyBody = `versionCode=444&novelId=${c.novelId}&chapterId=${c.chapterId}&commentId=${c.commentId}&offset=${offset}&limit=${limit}&isBackend=2&token=${getToken()}`;
        let replyPost = {
            "method": "POST",
            "body": replyBody
        }
        let replyList = java.ajax(replyUrl+","+JSON.stringify(replyPost));     
        replyList = JSON.parse(replyList).data;
        reply = reply.concat(replyList);                  
    }


        for (let j in reply) {
            let r = reply[j];
            if (re.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) : null)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            let authorTag = (r?.isAuthor === "1" ? "👑" : "📜")+r.floor+"楼 ";
            
            rl.push({
                text: `${authorTag} ${r.replyAuthor ?? r.commentauthor} (${(!r.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(r.comment_date_time *1000)) ?? (r.replyDate || r.commentdate)})\n ${replaceEmoticons(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody)}`
            });
        }
                               
        // 构建主评论
        let authorTag = "";
        if (c?.isAuthor === "1") {
            authorTag = "👑";
        } else if (c?.bulletinComment === "1") {
            authorTag = "📢";
        } else {
            authorTag = "👤";
        }

        // 主评论头部信息（作者、时间、订阅、互动数据）
             
        let header = `${authorTag} ${c.commentAuthor ?? c.commentauthor} `;
        let time = ` 📆${(!c.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(c.comment_date_time * 1000)) ?? (c.commentDate || c.commentdate || '')}`
        // 订阅信息     
        if (c.subscriptionicon) {
            if (c.subscriptionrate) {
                header += ` 📖${c.subscriptionrate}`;
            } else if (c.subscriptionicon.includes("rate_novelallbuy")) {
                header += ` 📖100%`;
            }
        }

        // 互动数据
        header += ` \n👍${c.agreenum ?? "0"}`;
        if (c.commentMark) header += ` ⭐️${c.commentMark}`;
        
        output += "\n"+header + time+ "\n";
        output += `${replaceEmoticons(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody)}`;




        // 回复内容
        if (rl.length > 0) {
            output += "\n‎\n🔁 回复内容:\n";
            rl.forEach(reply => {
                output += `  ${reply.text}\n`;
            });
        }
        if(replyTotal > 5 && !/◎缓存回复/.test(sss)){
        output= output.replace(/\n$/,'')+getImage(replyTotal,c.novelId,c.chapterId,c.commentId)
        }
	
        output += "\n‎\n";
        validCount++;
    }

    // 添加统计信息
    let stats = `🏷本章共有${commentTotal}条评论 | 共有${page}页\n💬当前第${p}页显示 ${validCount} 条评论 | 屏蔽 ${plen} 条评论`;
      
    return stats + "\n\n" + output;
}
let msg = d?.data.commentTotal?null:d.message;
if(msg){
	java.toast(msg);
}else{
result = getPlainText(d.data.commentList);
if(/\d+-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     if(/offset=0/.test(baseUrl)&&!/1-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     	result = ""
     	}
}
result.replace(/</g,'<')
.replace(/>/g,'>')
}
</js>

variableComment:
1、设置书籍变量处可填写（只会应用于当前书籍）

  开始页-结束页  ——   如10-20 
则评论从第10页开始，第20页结束
默认最多从第1页至第10页结束

2、设置源变量处可填写（应用于所有书）

屏蔽【屏蔽词,屏蔽词,屏蔽词】 ——  如 屏蔽【磕到了,营养液】只要有屏蔽词就不显示此评论。
注意用英文逗号【,】分隔屏蔽词，【】符号不能少。

 ◎数量  ——  如 ◎1000 则每页显示1000条评论，默认为500，注意数字太大可能会失败。
 
◎回复 —— 评论按照回复时间排序，默认为点赞数排序

◎长评 —— 只显示长评
 
 ◎缓存回复 —— 更多回复加载到正文（填写后刷新正文，❗️注意：当前页有很多评论有更多回复，会导致正文加载速度非常慢！有500条更多回复就要请求500次！），不填写则是刷新图片可以查看更多回复，正文加载速度较快。
 
 注意◎符号不能少。
 
（更改完书籍变量或源变量一定要先刷新详情页，再刷新正文）

bookSourceComment:
// Error: 发现失效

❗️一些功能
1、每隔八小时访问一遍签到（使用的时候访问）
2、点击“登录”自定义发现
3、更改过发现要刷新本书源才会生效
4、点击章节链接可以查看评论，注意要设置成内部浏览器，长按章节链接可以设置
5、设置源变量或设置书籍变量可以查看一些功能说明
❗️注意事项:
1、请不要退出晋江app的账号，只要点了退出，或者在其他地方登录了，都要重新抓token。
2、更新token，书籍就要更新目录。
3、【抓包token登录】和【账号登录】二选一，【抓包token登录】的优先级高些，填了【抓包token登录】，就是按【抓包token登录的值】登录
4、登录步骤【设备保护关闭的状态下】：
①填写好账号密码，点击“邮箱验证码”或者“手机验证码”
②填写好验证码，点击“邮箱登录”或者“手机登录”
③想要确认是否成功可以在登录UI里点右上角三点，查看登录头token里是否有值。
④如果弹出提示“请校检验证码”，可尝试填入上一次发送给你验证码。
5、如果邮箱和手机号无法登录，可能是需要过滑动验证码，可尝试先在晋江app里登录一遍后，再在阅读里登录，❗️还是不行就只能抓包token，填写在“抓包token登录”处。

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let pages = Array.from(java.getStringList('option@value', null, true));

var chapters = java.ajaxAll(pages).flatMap(m => {
    let chapterLists = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(m.body()).select('.section-list');
    return Array.from(chapterLists.get(1).select('a'));
});

var list = chapters.map((item, i) => {
    let url = String(item.attr('href'));
    if (!url) {
        let thUrl = i < chapters.length - 1 ? chapters[i+1].attr('href') : chapters[i-1].attr('href');
        let ruleStr = i < chapters.length - 1 ? "#prev_url@href" : "#next_url@href";
       if (String(thUrl)) url = "data:;base64," + java.base64Encode(ruleStr + "|" + thUrl) + ',{"type": "chapter"}';
    }
    //java.log(url)
    return { 
        name: item.text(), 
        Url: url
    };
});
list;
</js>

java.log(userInfo)
UNE=userInfo['手机号码/邮箱号']

url="{{source.getKey()}}/api/passport/login,";
SU=source.getKey()
body={

  "password": String(PWD),
  "mp_token": -1
}
option={
'method': 'POST',

}

url=url+JSON.stringify(option)
token=java.ajax(url).match(/"auth_token":"([^"]+)"/)[1]

Cookie={

	}

source.putLoginHeader(header)
}

var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))

if (baseUrl.startsWith('data')) {
    let decodedData = String(java.hexDecodeToString(src));
    let [ruleStr, initialUrl] = decodedData.split('|');
    let finalUrl = initialUrl;
    let initialCount = 0;
    const finalCount = 10;
    while (initialCount < finalCount) {
            initialCount++;
            let Content = java.ajax(source.key + finalUrl);
            let thUrl = java.getString(ruleStr, Content);
            finalUrl = thUrl;
         if (!thUrl.includes('_')) break;
    }
    result = java.ajax(source.key + finalUrl);
    java.setContent(result);
}
result;

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let pages = Array.from(java.getStringList('option@value', null, true));

var chapters = java.ajaxAll(pages).flatMap(m => {
    let chapterLists = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(m.body()).select('.section-list');
    return Array.from(chapterLists.get(1).select('a'));
});

var list = chapters.map((item, i) => {
    let url = String(item.attr('href'));
    if (!url) {
        let thUrl = i < chapters.length - 1 ? chapters[i+1].attr('href') : chapters[i-1].attr('href');
        let ruleStr = i < chapters.length - 1 ? "#prev_url@href" : "#next_url@href";
       if (String(thUrl)) url = "data:;base64," + java.base64Encode(ruleStr + "|" + thUrl) + ',{"type": "chapter"}';
    }
    //java.log(url)
    return { 
        name: item.text(), 
        Url: url
    };
});
list;
</js>

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);

  return paramStr;
};

<js>

if(jm.length()>1){
var conts = [],list=[];
code=result.match(/codeurl="(\d+)";/)[1];
data=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
datas=data.select("p[style*='text-indent']");
jm=String(jm).split(/[A-Z]+%/);
for(i=0;i<jm.length;i++){
	k=Math.ceil((i + 1) % parseInt(code));
	j=Math.ceil(jm[i] - k);
	conts[j]=datas[i];
	}
	for(i in conts){
		c=String(conts[i]).replace(/.*本章尚未读完,请.*一页继续阅读.*/g,'');
		list.push(c);
		list.join("\n");
		}
	}else{java.getString(".novelcontent@html")}
</js>

if(java.get("is_bundle")=="false"){ html = java.ajax("https://read.douban.com"); eval(html.match(/Ark\.(user = \{[\s\S]+?\})/)[1]); cok = user.id??"anonymous"; t = java.getString("$.data"); script = ``; ddd = java.webView(script,baseUrl,"result"); //规范Json数据 // 定义正则表达式 const pattern = /:"(.*?)"([,\]\}])/g; const bbb = book.getVariable("custom"); const sss = source.getVariable(); // 替换逻辑 ddd = String(ddd).replace(pattern, (match, content,suffix) => { // 将内容中的双引号替换为转义字符 const replacedContent = content.replace(/"/g, '\\"'); // 返回替换后的结果 return `:"${replacedContent}"${suffix}`; }).replace(/\n+/g,'\\n').replace(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/g,''); var data = JSON.parse(String(ddd)); function extractContent(item) { const textList = item.data?.text; const process = (content) => { if (typeof content === 'string') { if(content==""){ content ="\n‎\n" } return content; } if (Array.isArray(content)) { return content.map(process).join(''); } if (content && (content.content || content.content==="")) { let c; if(content.kind == "footnote"){ if(/1/.test(sss)||/1/.test(bbb))c = "【*"+content.content+"】" }else{ c = content.content } return process(c); } return ''; }; return process(textList); } function getChapterContent(chapterNumber) { let chapterContent = []; let currentChapter = -1; let isFirstHeadlineFound = false; for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) { let item = data[i]; if (item.type === 'headline') { currentChapter++; if (!isFirstHeadlineFound) { isFirstHeadlineFound = true; } if (currentChapter > chapterNumber) { break; } } if ((currentChapter === chapterNumber) || (chapterNumber === 0 && !isFirstHeadlineFound && item.type !== 'headline')) { if(item.type === "illus")chapterContent.push(`\n`); if(item.type !== 'headline')chapterContent.push(extractContent(item)); } } return chapterContent.length > 0 ? chapterContent.join('\n') : null; } result = ""; // 检查是否需要使用章节逻辑 if (book.bookUrl.includes("ebook")) { let index = chapter.index; result = getChapterContent(index); } else { // 遍历数据，提取并拼接 content data.forEach(item => { if(item.type === "illus")result += `\n` result += extractContent(item) + "\n"; // 每个段落换行 }); } }else{ bookName = java.getString("@class.article-title@text"); bookAuthor = java.getString("@class.author-item@text"); imgSrc = java.getString("@class.cover shadow-cover@img@src"); info = java.getString("@class.info@p@text"); result = `❗️刷新本章跳转加入书架界面❗️\n书名：${bookName}\n作者：${bookAuthor}\n\n简介：\n${info}` if(book.durChapterIndex === chapter.index){ url = "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src="+baseUrl; script = `data:text/html;charset=utf-8, 《${bookName}》加入书架

跳转加入书架

简介：${info}

`; java.startBrowser(script,"《"+bookName+"》") } } result
